name: amplicon-asv-taxonomy-diversity-workflow
description: Use when demultiplexed paired-end Illumina amplicon reads must be denoised into QIIME 2 ASV artifacts, assigned taxonomy, and summarized with alpha and beta diversity statistics in one coherent Tourmaline workflow.

name: edna-reference-curation-assignment-workflow
description: Use when eDNA COI MOTU sequences require a traceable reference set assembled from public records, curated with lineage reconciliation, formatted for OBITools, and assigned to the most specific consistent taxon.
